reviews.review_msg: Mahsa is one of the best math instructors I have ever had. She is patient, approachable, and makes students feel comfortable asking questions. The workload is heavy, but the course itself isn't too difficult. Her office hours have helped me a lot. She really cares about her students and wants us to understand the reasoning behind the math.

Mahsa is such an incredible and caring prof. Her classes are very well organized and makes sure every student understands her. She encourages questions, and always asks if they class is doing okay. The class itself was very easy if you come to class and do all the homework. 100% take this class with her, you won't regret it.
